expectations.text: Leads with the decisive rule: the ICT Health Law (Federal Law 2/2019) generally PROHIBITS storing/processing/transferring UAE health data outside the UAE — default answer: patient data cannot live in a US-hosted cloud
expectations.evidence: "Short answer up front: No, not by default. UAE health data generally cannot be stored, processed, generated, or transferred outside the UAE"; "Federal Law 2/2019" named as the controlling law.

expectations.text: States the exception pathway correctly: exceptions require authorization via the relevant health authority and MOHAP (Cabinet Decision 32/2020; Ministerial Resolution 51/2021 covers approved cases such as specified telemedicine) — not fixable by contracts alone
expectations.evidence: "Federal Law 2/2019 (+ Cabinet Decision 32/2020, Ministerial Resolution 51/2021) prohibits... unless an exception is specifically authorized by the relevant health authority and MOHAP... requires a formal approval, not a contractual workaround. Don't assume a DPA or encryption gets you there."

expectations.text: Quantifies exposure: localization violations carry fines of AED 500,000-700,000
Routes to the right authority for a Dubai private hospital (DHA, with MOHAP at federal level) and notes the law prevails over the federal PDPL via the health-data carve-out
expectations.evidence: "Relevant health authority for a Dubai hospital: DHA. Federal oversight: MOHAP."; "it's a sector overlay that prevails over general privacy carve-outs" and separately routes non-health data to federal PDPL.

expectations.text: Gives the practical architecture answer: in-UAE hosting (or an authorized exception) for patient data, with a split analysis for non-health personal data (federal PDPL readiness posture) — and advises the vendor to verify current authority guidance before promising any exception
expectations.evidence: Options given: in-country hosting, authorized exception, data splitting; "Non-health personal data... likely federal PDPL... treat this as a readiness posture rather than a fully operational enforcement regime"; closing disclaimer to confirm exception pathways with MOHAP/DHA before finalizing.
